overview: The Board of Health approved a grease trap pumping variance for a food manufacturer and reviewed a biosafety permit application for a biotech facility relocating to Boston Avenue. The board also discussed tobacco permit suspension guidelines and received a regional infectious disease report.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the minutes of the previous meeting.

items.title: Grease Trap Variance: 101 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: Approved a variance extending grease trap pumping frequency from every four months to six months for Just Us Foods Inc., provided facility operations do not add oily foods.

items.title: Hearing Postponement: 543 Riverside Avenue
items.summary: Postponed consideration of 543 Riverside Avenue because the owner was not in attendance.

items.title: Biosafety Permit: Wiser Biosciences
items.summary: Reviewed a Biosafety Level 2 permit application from Wiser Biosciences for their relocation to 200 Boston Avenue, with staff planning to issue the permit after completing final documentation review.

items.title: Tobacco Regulation Suspension Language
items.summary: Discussed whether local tobacco violation rules should mirror state language regarding discretionary versus mandatory suspensions and consecutive days, with members favoring prospective alignment.

items.title: Quarterly Infectious Disease Report
items.summary: Received a quarterly infectious disease report from regional epidemiologist Guha Patel and noted upcoming schedules for the mobile health clinic van.
